definitions.short: reddish (of the hair or the complexion)
definitions.full: H132. admoni אַדְמוֺנִי adjective red, ruddy , of Esau as newborn babe Gen 25:25 (whence name Edom accusative to E ? compare Di); of youth 1Sam 16:12 ; 17:42 ( אַדְמֹנִי ).
